notes: This portable C++ TCK scenario uses only IEEE 1516.1 RTIambassador and FederateAmbassador interfaces and the C++ standard library. The adapter supplies the provider package, FOM, endpoint, callback model, and logical-time implementation. It checks ordinary and timestamped Update Attribute Values at one receiver and distinguishes the corresponding reflection callback overloads without provider-specific names, headers, registries, or behavior.

api_surfaces.signature: RTIambassador ordinary and timestamped Update Attribute Values, object publication, attribute order control, time-role, and time-advance services with FederateAmbassador ordinary and timestamped reflection callbacks
api_surfaces.source_symbol: IEEE 1516.1 RTIambassador and FederateAmbassador object-management and time-management declarations
